soundness.screen: tools/splitRefinedScreens.ts S1, generalised by R74 to all three axes: dim span{slices along axis a} >= j+1 REFUTES a deficit that must be a sum of j rank-1 tensors. Integer arithmetic, no float, no budget, no branch and bound.
soundness.deficitIsTheTrueOne: D_K = M - sum_{s not in K} t_s against the TRUE target, NOT sum_{s in K} t_s (R79's catch). Verified by the zero-deficit alignment control below.
soundness.dedupIsSound: anchor labels are not unique (maxLabelMultiplicity=7) because cutIdx = min(cut, supp.length-1) collapses larger cuts onto the same split; same label => same anchor, so dedup by label is exact coverage, and all 1330 positions map onto the 599 distinct anchors.
soundness.exactness: rationals only. No float appears in any equality decision, here or in the screen.
